text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"organized into introduction, three body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a clear, controlled structure that helps the argument unfold logically."},{"evidence":"repeated topic sentences like 'Firstly,' 'Secondly,' and 'Thirdly,'","quality":"cohesive sequencing","description":"The essay uses explicit transitions to guide the reader through each main point."},{"evidence":"extended explanations of confidence, challenge, and pride","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops each idea with elaboration rather than merely stating a claim."},{"evidence":"examples from tennis, honors courses, and a writing competition","quality":"supporting detail","description":"The essay uses specific personal examples to illustrate and strengthen its points."},{"evidence":"'despite not making it onto the team' and 'even if I fell short'","quality":"concession handling","description":"The essay acknowledges setbacks and still connects them back to its main argument in a mature way."},{"evidence":"sentences like 'This is because...' and 'Therefore...'","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay explains causal relationships and draws conclusions from its examples."},{"evidence":"'my abilties,' 'capabilites,' 'emmits'","quality":"spelling control","description":"The essay has fewer noticeable spelling errors than the other essay, showing stronger command of written English."},{"evidence":"complex sentences with subordinate clauses","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"The essay uses longer, more varied sentence structures to express nuanced ideas."}]}
